findings.title: Controlled empty value no longer clears stale filled on mount
findings.why_it_matters: When a controlled Field.Control mounts into a Field.Root that already has filled=true (the control was keyed/remounted, or conditionally hidden while the value was cleared), the root keeps data-filled even though the input is empty. The base mount effect handled this with `else if (hasExternalValue && valueProp === '') setFilled(false)`; the new effect only ever sets filled to true, and useValueChanged skips the mount render. A scratch test (keyed remount with value changed 'abc' -> '') confirms data-filled stays set on HEAD, whereas the base effect would have cleared it. Narrow trigger (remount into an existing root with a changed value), so impact is limited to stale styling such as a raised floating label.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the controlled-empty branch in the mount effect: `if (validation.inputRef.current?.value) { setFilled(true); } else if (serializedValue === '') { setFilled(false); }` (mount-only, reading serializedValue from the first render), and add a test that remounts a controlled control with an empty value into a filled root.
evidence: base 30b8ea200 FieldControl.tsx -- } else if (hasExternalValue && valueProp === '') { setFilled(false); }
scratch test: <Field.Control key={k} value={v} .../>, click sets v='' and k=1 -> root.hasAttribute('data-filled') === true on HEAD

residual_risks: Registration value is now String(value), so Form-submit / actionsRef validation (useFieldControlRegistration.validate -> commit(registration.value)) passes a string to `validate` for non-string controlled values (number 5 -> '5', array -> 'a,b') where it previously passed the original value; consistent with the keystroke path but a silent contract change for validators that type-check.

In controlled mode, preventBaseUIHandler or a defaultPrevented native event no longer suppresses clearErrors/validation if the consumer still updates `value` (field sync now keys off the prop). Scratch test showed Form server errors still render in the prevented controlled case, so no confirmed user-visible regression.
testing_gaps: No test covers a controlled Field.Control remounting (or reappearing) inside an existing Field.Root with an empty or changed value; filled/dirty baseline on remount is untested.
